success.hint: No domain-specific guidance is available for this command yet.
success.why: The command exited successfully, but no Recover or Next rule matched.

failure.hint: No domain-specific recovery rule is available for this command yet.
failure.why: The command failed, but no Recover rule matched the captured output.

identityFailure.status: The docs command failed because the selected identity is unsupported.
identityFailure.hint: Retry the same command with user identity.
identityFailure.why: The captured output says this command supports user identity or suggests --as user.

searchSuccess.hint: The search result is only an entry point. Fetch the document body before extracting decisions, risks, or action items.
searchSuccess.why: Current lark-cli docs fetch uses --doc with a document URL or token.

fetchSuccess.hint: The document body is available. The next useful step is to prepare a Feishu group message for review.
fetchSuccess.why: The MVP demonstrates active distribution by suggesting an im send command, but it must not send automatically.
fetchSuccess.markdown: Knowledge hint from {{title}}: review the fetched document content, then send the confirmed summary to the project group.

docToken.status: docs +fetch failed because the command used an outdated flag.
docToken.why: The wrapped command arguments include --doc-token, while the installed lark-cli help exposes --doc.

missingDoc.hint: Pass a document URL or token with --doc, or search docs first to find one.
missingDoc.why: The wrapped command does not include --doc or --doc-token.

wikiToken.status: docs +fetch may be using a wiki node token.
wikiToken.hint: A wiki node token is not always the document body token. Search or resolve the wiki resource before fetching the document body.
wikiToken.why: The --doc value looks like a wiki resource, and this change does not resolve wiki nodes through extra API calls.

notConfigured.status: lark-cli is not configured for this docs request.
notConfigured.hint: Initialize lark-cli configuration before fetching documents.
notConfigured.why: The captured output contains a not configured error from lark-cli.

identity.status: docs +fetch failed because the selected identity is unsupported.
identity.hint: Retry the fetch with a supported identity flag.
identity.why: The captured output says the resolved identity is not supported for this command.

generic.hint: No known docs Recover rule matched this failure.
generic.why: The command failed, but the captured evidence does not identify a supported docs workflow fix.

errors.missingCommand: Missing wrapped command. Provide a command after --, for example: lark-cli-hint run -- lark-cli --version
